headline: Italy's Meloni, once Trump's closest ally in Europe, says he made up a story about her
context: "Italy and I do not beg," Meloni said in a video rebuke posted on social media Friday. Italy's top diplomat, meanwhile, said he was cancelling a visit to the U.S because of the alleged remarks.
